response.sql:
WITH channel_rates AS (
  SELECT o.orderbase, AVG(f.feerate) AS mean_fee_rate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink
  WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.orderbase
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(feerate) AS overall_mean_fee_rate
  FROM fees
  WHERE feerate IS NOT NULL
), above_average AS (
  SELECT cr.mean_fee_rate, cr.mean_fee_rate - overall.overall_mean_fee_rate AS amount_above_average
  FROM channel_rates AS cr
  CROSS JOIN overall
  WHERE cr.mean_fee_rate > overall.overall_mean_fee_rate
)
SELECT AVG(mean_fee_rate) AS mean_average_fee_rate,
       AVG(amount_above_average) AS average_amount_above_average
FROM above_average;

assumptions.assumption: “Average fee rate” means each channel’s mean feerate, compared with the overall mean of non-null fee rates for fees tied to orders; the output averages the qualifying channels equally.

alternatives.interpretation: If the overall benchmark should include every fee record, including fees not linked to an order, use this query; the channel results and final averages remain limited to fees tied to orders.
